entities.summary: Baba Tahir or Baba Taher Oryan Hamadani was an 11th-century dervish poet from Hamadan, Iran who lived during the reign of Tugril of the Seljuk dynasty over Iran. This is almost all that is known of him as he lived a mysterious lifestyle. Although the prefix "Baba" has been thought as part of his name in all known sources, his nickname "Oryan" did not appear until about 17th century. It is likely that the nickname was attributed to him because he seemed to lead a very spiritual and stoic lifestyle and thus was figuratively not clothed with worldly and material needs and suggests he may have been a wandering dervish.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a dervish poet from Hamadan, Iran, Baba Tahir's spiritual and stoic lifestyle had limited regional impact but contributes to the rich cultural heritage of Persian literature. His enigmatic nature has led to ongoing scholarly interest in his life and works.
